title: Understanding Overfitting
text: Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too well, capturing noise along with the underlying pattern. Think about how using the entire training set for each fold might affect the model's ability to generalize.

title: Role of the Test Set
text: Consider the purpose of a test set in cross-validation. How does using a subset of the test set for validation differ from using a subset of the training set?

hintAnswer: To estimate the model's performance on unseen data
title: Evaluating the Modification
text: What is the primary goal of cross-validation? Is it to minimize training error or to estimate the model's performance on unseen data?
choices: To estimate the model's performance on unseen data

hintAnswer: It may lead to overfitting as the model might learn noise from the training data.
title: Impact of Using the Entire Training Set
text: If the entire training set is used for each fold, how might this affect the model's ability to generalize to new data?
choices: It may lead to overfitting as the model might learn noise from the training data.
It will improve the model's ability to generalize to new data.
